scope: Headless GUT shutdown after all project tests. Raw counts include Godot-held global script classes; they may only be recalibrated after an audited pinned GF vendor-tree or project runtime class-set change, and must not grow while both inputs remain unchanged.
calibration_reason: The exact official GF 11.0.0 stable tag is pinned at e88ea347 after its canonical release workflow succeeded and the annotated tag, release manifest, archive digest, Git tree, and every vendored blob were verified. It is a linear four-commit finalization of the previously audited 11.0.0-dev.0 snapshot; the audited diff adds no global script classes and changes runtime semantics only in GFAssetUtility owner cleanup and GFConsoleUtility visibility control. The GF global script class count therefore remains 874 and the audited project runtime class set remains 293; Godot remains pinned to 4.7.2. The reviewed ObjectDB, Resource, RID, and PagedAllocator ceilings are intentionally retained without increase and must still pass the full shutdown gate.
